'''''Icy Moon''''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Light Patrol Ship]] owned and operated by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rafe Finna]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was present at [[Gadde]] on [[Lish V]] to transport [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] prisoners.
